howToActivate: This record is a proposal only (approvalToken is a placeholder, not a real approval). Once the owner sets approvalToken to the literal string "OWNER APPROVED" after independently verifying the six digests above against the actual candidate diff, copy this object (with the signed token) into product/dependency-verification.json's top-level "controlGatePinBump" field on this branch and re-run the control-gate CI check.
